## Overall Evaluation Summary

Kaushik Ranjan is a technically competent candidate in media production (video and poster design) who lacks the strategic marketing depth and cultural alignment required for the role. In the HR round, he confirmed full availability and 6-month commitment, but his career focus is heavily aligned with UGC NET academic prep. In the Natural Fit round, he showed solid execution capabilities in video editing but struggled to define consistency and data analytics. Most importantly, his initial reaction to diversity ('Why will I work with someone who is different from me?') represents a severe alignment issue with the organization's inclusive values. Therefore, he is not recommended for the role.
